title: NearWave Receives Patent Award from the EU
summary: We are happy to announce that our frequency domain diffuse optical spectroscopy technology and optical detector calibration method has been awarded a patent by the European Patent Organization!
body_markdown:
We are happy to announce that our frequency domain diffuse optical spectroscopy technology and optical detector calibration method has been awarded a patent by the European Patent Organization!


[See Patent](https://patents.google.com/patent/EP3773204B1/en)
